vertebrae.extractors.torch
==========================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.extractors.torch

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Optional Torch module extractor for local user-supplied models.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.extractors.torch.TorchExtractor


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: TorchExtractor(name, model, collate_fn, output_fn = None, device = None, modality = 'unknown', extractor_type = 'custom_torch', recipe_data = None, allow_sparse = False, streaming_safe = True, move_batch_to_device = True, move_model_to_device = True)

   Wrap a locally loaded PyTorch module as a feature extractor.

   :param name: User-facing extractor name.
   :param model: A locally loaded ``torch.nn.Module`` or compatible callable object.
   :param collate_fn: Callable that converts a batch of raw inputs into model inputs.
   :param output_fn: Optional callable that converts raw model output into embeddings.
   :param device: Optional device string passed to ``model.to(...)`` and batch items.
   :param modality: Input modality metadata.
   :param extractor_type: Extractor family metadata.
   :param recipe_data: Extra serializable metadata for reproducibility.
   :param allow_sparse: Whether sparse embedding outputs are accepted.
   :param streaming_safe: Whether independent batches can be embedded without full-context state.
   :param move_batch_to_device: Whether tensor-like batch items should be moved to ``device``.
   :param move_model_to_device: Whether the model should be moved to ``device`` once on first use.


   .. py:method:: fit(X, y = None)

      No-op fit for local Torch models.



   .. py:method:: transform(X)

      Apply the collate function, run the model, and validate embeddings.



   .. py:method:: fit_transform(X, y = None)

      Fit the extractor and transform inputs.



   .. py:method:: recipe()

      Return a serializable recipe for this extractor.
